asidePark.hi: {aside} ki baat bhi hogi, bas yeh gol wala kaam khatam ho jaaye.

hook.convey: round things around us have a middle point and straight lines from it → a bike wheel's hub = centre, each spoke = a radius, all spokes the same length; a roti folded through its middle → the fold line = a diameter

use.hi: Bike ke pahiye ke beech mein hub hota hai, aur wahan se spokes kinaare tak jaate hain. Hub circle ke centre jaisa hai, aur har spoke ek radius jaisa, sab ek hi lambai ke.
use.en: A bike wheel has a hub in the middle, and spokes go from there to the rim. The hub is like the circle's centre, and each spoke is like a radius, all of the same length.

use.hi: Gol roti ko theek beech se mod do, toh mod ki line ek kinaare se centre se hote hue doosre kinaare tak jaati hai. Yahi line roti ka diameter hai.
use.en: Fold a round roti exactly through its middle, and the fold line goes from one edge through the centre to the other edge. That line is the roti's diameter.

explain.convey: circle → one fixed middle point = centre (kendra); a straight line from the centre to the edge = radius (trijya); every point of the edge is the same distance from the centre → every radius of one circle is equal; radius 4 cm on the board

point.hi: Yeh circle hai aur beech ka bindu iska centre hai. Centre se kinaare tak jo arrow hai, woh radius hai, 4 cm. Kinaare par koi bhi jagah lo, centre se uski doori 4 cm hi rehti hai.
point.en: This is a circle and the dot in the middle is its centre. The arrow from the centre to the edge is the radius, 4 cm. Take any place on the edge, and its distance from the centre stays 4 cm.

prompt.hi: Is circle ke kinaare par koi do alag points lo. Centre se dono ki doori jodo, toh kitna hoga?
prompt.en: Take any two different points on the edge of this circle. Add their distances from the centre. What do you get?

why.hi: kinaare ka har point centre se 4 cm par hai, aur 4 + 4 = 8
why.en: every point on the edge is 4 cm from the centre, and 4 + 4 = 8

simpler.hi: Centre se kinaare tak ki doori radius hai, 4 cm. Kinaare par koi bhi jagah lo, woh centre se 4 cm hi door hogi.
simpler.en: The distance from the centre to the edge is the radius, 4 cm. Any place on the edge is 4 cm from the centre.

explain.convey: a straight line from edge to edge THROUGH the centre = diameter (vyaas); the centre splits it into two radii, OA and OB → diameter = 2 × radius; the child finds AB from OA = 6 cm

point.hi: Yeh line circle ke ek kinaare se doosre kinaare tak jaati hai, aur beech mein centre O se guzarti hai. Aisi line diameter kehlati hai. Centre O ise do barabar hisson mein baant-ta hai, aur har hissa ek radius hai, isliye diameter = 2 × radius.
point.en: This line goes from one edge of the circle to the other and passes through the centre O. Such a line is called a diameter. The centre O splits it into two equal parts, and each part is a radius, so diameter = 2 × radius.

prompt.hi: Is circle mein OA 6 cm ho, toh diameter AB kitna lamba hoga?
prompt.en: If OA is 6 cm in this circle, how long is the diameter AB?

why.hi: AB mein centre ke dono taraf ek-ek radius hai, aur 6 + 6 = 12
why.en: AB has one radius on each side of the centre, and 6 + 6 = 12

simpler.hi: AB ek kinaare se doosre kinaare tak centre O se hokar jaati hai. Centre ke dono taraf ek-ek radius hai, toh diameter do radius jitna hai.
simpler.en: AB goes from edge to edge through the centre O. There is one radius on each side of the centre, so a diameter is as long as two radii.

explain.convey: not every edge-to-edge line is a diameter: AB passes through the centre → diameter; CD misses the centre → a chord (jeeva); the diameter is the longest chord → only the line through the centre gives the radius when halved

mustSay.en: does not pass through the centre

point.hi: AB aur CD dono circle ke ek kinaare se doosre kinaare tak jaati hain. AB centre se guzarti hai, isliye woh diameter hai. CD centre se nahi guzarti, woh ek chord hai. Diameter circle ki sabse lambi chord hoti hai.
point.en: AB and CD both go from one edge of the circle to the other. AB passes through the centre, so it is a diameter. CD does not pass through the centre; it is a chord. The diameter is the longest chord of a circle.

prompt.hi: Is circle mein AB 10 cm hai aur CD 8 cm. Circle ka radius kitna hai?
prompt.en: In this circle AB is 10 cm and CD is 8 cm. What is the radius of the circle?

why.hi: AB centre se guzarti hai toh diameter 10 cm hai, aur 10 ÷ 2 = 5
why.en: AB passes through the centre so the diameter is 10 cm, and 10 ÷ 2 = 5

simpler.hi: AB centre ko chhoo kar nikalti hai, toh diameter wahi hai. CD centre se door rehti hai, isliye woh sirf ek chord hai.
simpler.en: AB runs through the centre, so AB is the diameter. CD stays away from the centre, so it is only a chord.

problem.hi: Ek gol ghadi ka centre O hai. A aur B ghadi ke kinaare par hain, aur seedhi line AB, O se guzarti hai. OA 7 cm hai. Radius aur diameter ke naam batao, aur AB ki lambai nikalo.
problem.en: A round clock has its centre at O. A and B are on the edge of the clock, and the straight line AB passes through O. OA is 7 cm. Name the radius and the diameter, and find the length of AB.

simpler.hi: Centre se kinaare tak ki line radius hoti hai. Centre se hokar ek kinaare se doosre kinaare tak ki line diameter hoti hai. Ab dekho OA aur AB kaun si hain.
simpler.en: A line from the centre to the edge is a radius. A line from edge to edge through the centre is a diameter. Now see which ones OA and AB are.

givens.en: O is the centre of the clock

givens.hi: A aur B kinaare par hain
givens.en: A and B are on the edge

find.hi: kaunsi line radius hai, kaunsi diameter, aur AB kitni lambi hai
find.en: which line is a radius, which is the diameter, and how long AB is

do.hi: OA ko dekho, yeh centre O se kinaare tak jaati hai
do.en: Look at OA; it goes from the centre O to the edge

why.hi: centre se kinaare tak ki seedhi line radius hoti hai
why.en: a straight line from the centre to the edge is a radius

simpler.hi: OA centre O se kinaare tak jaati hai. Centre se kinaare tak ki seedhi line radius hoti hai, yahan 7 cm.
simpler.en: OA goes from the centre O to the edge. A straight line from the centre to the edge is a radius, here 7 cm.

do.hi: Ab OB ko dekho, yeh bhi O se kinaare tak hai
do.en: Now look at OB; it also goes from O to the edge

why.hi: ek circle ke saare radius barabar hote hain
why.en: all the radii of one circle are equal

simpler.hi: OB bhi O se kinaare tak jaati hai. Ek circle ke saare radius barabar hote hain, toh OB bhi 7 cm hai.
simpler.en: OB also goes from O to the edge. All radii of one circle are equal, so OB is 7 cm too.

do.hi: AB ko dekho, yeh kinaare se O se hote hue kinaare tak hai
do.en: Look at AB; it goes from edge to edge through O

why.hi: yeh centre se guzarti hai aur dono kinaaron ko jodti hai
why.en: it passes through the centre and joins the two edges

simpler.hi: AB ek kinaare se doosre kinaare tak O se hokar jaati hai. Centre se guzarne wali aisi line diameter hai.
simpler.en: AB goes from one edge to the other through O. Such a line through the centre is a diameter.

do.hi: AB ko O ke dono taraf dekho: OA aur OB
do.en: Look at AB on both sides of O: OA and OB

why.hi: diameter mein centre ke dono taraf ek-ek radius hota hai
why.en: the diameter has one radius on each side of the centre

simpler.hi: AB mein O ke dono taraf ek-ek radius hai, OA aur OB. Isliye AB = 7 + 7.
simpler.en: AB has one radius on each side of O, OA and OB. So AB = 7 + 7.

prompt.hi: Toh poora diameter AB kitne cm lamba hai?
prompt.en: So how many cm long is the whole diameter AB?

simpler.hi: 7 mein ek aur 7 jodo. Wahi AB ki lambai hai.
simpler.en: Add another 7 to 7. That is the length of AB.

why.hi: OA aur OB dono 7 cm ke radius hain, aur 7 + 7 = 14
why.en: OA and OB are both radii of 7 cm, and 7 + 7 = 14

answer.hi: OA aur OB radius hain, 7 cm har ek, aur AB diameter hai, 14 cm lamba
answer.en: OA and OB are radii, 7 cm each, and AB is the diameter, 14 cm long

why.hi: diameter mein centre ke ek taraf ek radius hai aur doosri taraf doosra, isliye diameter radius ka dugna hota hai
why.en: the diameter has one radius on each side of the centre, so the diameter is twice the radius

prompt.hi: Ek gol plate ka diameter 18 cm hai. Iska radius kitna hai?
prompt.en: A round plate has a diameter of 18 cm. What is its radius?

why.hi: radius diameter ka aadha hai, aur 18 ÷ 2 = 9
why.en: the radius is half the diameter, and 18 ÷ 2 = 9

simpler.hi: Radius diameter ka aadha hota hai. 18 ko do barabar hisson mein baanto.
simpler.en: The radius is half the diameter. Share 18 into two equal parts.

prompt.hi: Ek circle mein chord PQ 9 cm hai aur centre se nahi guzarti. Kya is circle ka radius 4.5 cm ho sakta hai: haan ya nahi?
prompt.en: In a circle, chord PQ is 9 cm and does not pass through the centre. Can the radius of this circle be 4.5 cm: yes or no?

why.hi: PQ centre se nahi guzarti, toh diameter 9 cm se lamba hai, aur radius 4.5 cm se zyada
why.en: PQ misses the centre, so the diameter is longer than 9 cm, and the radius is more than 4.5 cm

simpler.hi: Jo chord centre se nahi guzarti, woh diameter se chhoti hoti hai. Socho, yahan diameter 9 cm se chhota hoga ya bada.
simpler.en: A chord that misses the centre is shorter than the diameter. Think whether this diameter is shorter or longer than 9 cm.

ladder.why: name a segment from where its ends lie: centre to edge on a badge → radius
first use of diameter = 2 × radius: radius 5 cm → diameter
two edge-to-edge segments on a cricket target: only the one through the centre is the diameter
explain the rule itself: why a diameter is exactly two radii

remediation.move: radius and diameter in two colours over one centre: radius = centre → edge, diameter = edge → centre → edge; fold the circle on the diameter at the centre → two radii fill one diameter → radius = half, never double

say.hi: Radius centre se kinaare tak jaata hai, aur diameter ek kinaare se centre se hote hue doosre kinaare tak. Diameter ko centre par mod kar dekho, usme do radius poore aa jaate hain.
say.en: The radius goes from the centre to the edge, and the diameter goes from one edge through the centre to the other edge. Fold the diameter at the centre and see: two whole radii fit in it.

simpler.hi: Radius centre se kinaare tak jaata hai. Diameter ko centre par modo, toh usme do radius aa jaate hain.
simpler.en: The radius goes from the centre to the edge. Fold the diameter at the centre and two radii fit in it.

prompt.hi: Gol roti ko theek beech se modne par mod ki line 26 cm lambi bani. Roti ke centre se kinaare tak kitne cm hai?
prompt.en: Folding a round roti through its middle gives a 26 cm fold line. How many cm is it from its centre to its edge?

why.hi: mod ki line centre se guzarti hai, toh woh diameter hai, aur 26 ÷ 2 = 13
why.en: the fold line passes through the centre, so it is the diameter, and 26 ÷ 2 = 13

simpler.hi: Mod ki line roti ka diameter hai. Centre se kinaare tak uska sirf aadha hissa aata hai.
simpler.en: The fold line is the roti's diameter. From the centre to the edge is only half of it.

remediation.move: slide a line across the circle edge to edge and watch its length: short near the edge, longest exactly when it passes the centre → only that position is the diameter; any other line is a shorter chord and halving it does not give the radius

say.hi: Ek line ko circle ke upar se kinaare se kinaare tak dheere-dheere khiskao. Woh tab sabse lambi hoti hai jab centre se guzarti hai, aur sirf wahi diameter hai.
say.en: Slide a line slowly across the circle, edge to edge. It is longest when it passes through the centre, and only that line is the diameter.

simpler.hi: Kinaare se kinaare tak wali line centre se guzre tabhi sabse lambi hoti hai. Wahi line diameter hai.
simpler.en: An edge-to-edge line is longest only when it passes through the centre. That line is the diameter.

prompt.hi: Ek circle mein do lines kinaare se kinaare tak hain, PQ 10 cm aur RS 16 cm. Ek centre se guzarti hai. Kaun si: PQ ya RS?
prompt.en: In a circle two lines go edge to edge, PQ 10 cm and RS 16 cm. One passes through the centre. Which one: PQ or RS?

why.hi: centre se guzarne wali line sabse lambi hoti hai, toh lambi wali RS hi centre se guzarti hai
why.en: the line through the centre is the longest, so the longer one, RS, is the one through the centre

simpler.hi: Socho, centre se guzarne wali line chhoti hoti hai ya sabse lambi. Phir dono lambaiyan milao.
simpler.en: Think whether the line through the centre is short or the longest. Then compare the two lengths.

bridgeToNext.hi: Ab centre, radius aur diameter pehchaan liye. Agle hisse mein compass se khud ek diye hue radius ka circle banayenge.
bridgeToNext.en: Now we can recognise the centre, the radius and the diameter. In the next part we will draw a circle of a given radius ourselves with a compass.

simpler.hi: Ab compass se circle banana seekhenge. Board par compass se bana ek circle hai.
simpler.en: Now we learn to draw a circle with a compass. On the board there is a circle drawn with a compass.

hook.convey: a circle drawn by hand never comes out truly round → a compass keeps the distance fixed, so the circle closes perfectly; arcs of the same opening make a flower design

use.hi: Drawing mein haath se ekdum gol circle banana mushkil hai. Compass se banao toh circle poora gol aata hai, kyunki nok ek jagah tiki rehti hai aur khulaav nahi badalta.
use.en: In drawing, making a perfectly round circle by hand is hard. Draw it with a compass and the circle comes out fully round, because the point stays in one place and the opening does not change.

use.hi: Compass ka khulaav same rakhkar circle ke kinaare par chhe arc banao, toh kaagaz par ek flower jaisa design ban jaata hai.
use.en: Keep the compass opening the same and draw six arcs on the edge of a circle, and a flower-like design appears on the paper.

explain.convey: compass = a sharp point (nok) + a pencil; the distance between point and pencil tip = the opening (khulaav) = the radius of the circle it draws; opened to 3 cm → radius 3 cm on the board

point.hi: Compass ki ek taraf nukeeli nok hai aur doosri taraf pencil. Nok aur pencil ke beech ki doori ko khulaav kehte hain, aur yahi khulaav circle ka radius banta hai. Yeh circle 3 cm ke khulaav se bana hai, isliye iska radius 3 cm hai.
point.en: A compass has a sharp point on one side and a pencil on the other. The distance between the point and the pencil is called the opening, and this opening becomes the circle's radius. This circle was drawn with a 3 cm opening, so its radius is 3 cm.

prompt.hi: Is circle ka diameter kitna hai?
prompt.en: What is the diameter of this circle?

why.hi: 3 cm ka khulaav hi radius hai, aur diameter = 2 × 3 = 6
why.en: the 3 cm opening is the radius, and the diameter = 2 × 3 = 6

simpler.hi: Compass ki nok aur pencil ke beech ki doori khulaav hai, aur wahi radius banti hai. Yahan khulaav 3 cm hai, toh radius 3 cm.
simpler.en: The gap between the compass point and the pencil is the opening, and it becomes the radius. Here the opening is 3 cm, so the radius is 3 cm.

explain.convey: diameter given → the point sits on the centre and the pencil on the edge → the compass spans only centre to edge → open it to HALF the diameter, never the whole diameter; diameter 14 cm on the board

mustSay.en: from the centre to the edge

point.hi: Is circle ka diameter 14 cm hai. Banate waqt compass ki nok centre O par rehti hai aur pencil kinaare par, yaani compass sirf centre se kinaare tak khulta hai, poore diameter tak nahi. Isliye compass ko diameter ka aadha kholte hain.
point.en: This circle's diameter is 14 cm. While drawing, the compass point stays on the centre O and the pencil on the edge, so the compass opens only from the centre to the edge, not across the whole diameter. So we open the compass to half the diameter.

prompt.hi: Toh is circle ko banane ke liye compass kitna khologe?
prompt.en: So how wide will you open the compass to draw this circle?

why.hi: compass sirf centre se kinaare tak khulta hai, aur 14 ÷ 2 = 7
why.en: the compass opens only from the centre to the edge, and 14 ÷ 2 = 7

simpler.hi: Compass ki nok centre par aur pencil kinaare par rehti hai. Isliye compass sirf centre se kinaare tak khulta hai, yaani diameter ka aadha.
simpler.en: The compass point stays on the centre and the pencil on the edge. So the compass opens only from centre to edge, half the diameter.

explain.convey: while turning, the opening must stay fixed → every point the pencil draws stays one radius from the point; an opening that slips → the curve comes nearer or farther → not a circle; turning only part of the way → a piece of a circle = arc (chaap)

point.hi: Compass 4 cm kholo, nok centre par tikao aur pencil ghumao. Ghumate waqt khulaav same rehna chahiye, tabhi har point nok se 4 cm par aata hai. Pencil sirf thoda sa ghume, toh circle ka ek hissa banta hai, use arc kehte hain.
point.en: Open the compass to 4 cm, fix the point on the centre and turn the pencil. While turning, the opening must stay the same; only then does every point come at 4 cm from the point. If the pencil turns only a little, a piece of a circle is drawn, called an arc.

prompt.hi: Ghumate waqt {friend} ka compass 4 cm se khisak kar 5 cm khul gaya. Kya bani shape circle hogi: haan ya nahi?
prompt.en: While turning, {friend}'s compass slipped open from 4 cm to 5 cm. Will the shape drawn be a circle: yes or no?

why.hi: pehle points centre se 4 cm par aaye, aur khisakne ke baad wale 5 cm par
why.en: the points drawn before came 4 cm from the centre, and those after the slip 5 cm

simpler.hi: Compass 4 cm kholo aur nok centre par rakho. Ghumate waqt khulaav same rahe, tabhi har point 4 cm par aata hai.
simpler.en: Open the compass to 4 cm and put the point on the centre. Only if the opening stays the same while turning does every point land at 4 cm.

problem.hi: Kaagaz par 16 cm diameter ka circle banana hai. Compass kitna khologe, aur circle kaise banaoge?
problem.en: A circle with a diameter of 16 cm is to be drawn on paper. How wide will you open the compass, and how will you draw the circle?

simpler.hi: Circle 16 cm chauda hona chahiye. Hamein compass ka khulaav aur banane ka tareeka nikalna hai.
simpler.en: The circle must be 16 cm across. We must find the compass opening and the way to draw it.

givens.hi: compass aur scale paas mein hain
givens.en: a compass and a ruler are at hand

find.hi: compass ka khulaav, aur circle banane ka tareeka
find.en: the compass opening, and the way to draw the circle

do.hi: Kaagaz par centre ka ek nishaan lagao, O
do.en: Put a mark for the centre on the paper, O

why.hi: compass ki nok yahin tiki rahegi
why.en: the compass point will stay fixed here

simpler.hi: Kagaz par ek nishaan lagao, yeh centre O hai. Compass ki nok yahin tiki rahegi.
simpler.en: Put a mark on the paper; this is the centre O. The compass point will stay fixed here.

do.hi: Socho compass kitna khulega: nok centre par, pencil kinaare par
do.en: Think how wide the compass opens: point on the centre, pencil on the edge

why.hi: nok se pencil tak sirf centre se kinaare tak ki doori hoti hai
why.en: from the point to the pencil is only the distance from the centre to the edge

simpler.hi: Nok centre par hai aur pencil kinaare par. Toh khulaav sirf centre se kinaare tak hai, yaani diameter ka aadha.
simpler.en: The point is on the centre and the pencil on the edge. So the opening is only centre to edge, half the diameter.

prompt.hi: Diameter 16 cm hai. Uska aadha, yaani compass ka khulaav, kitne cm hai?
prompt.en: The diameter is 16 cm. What is half of it, that is, the compass opening, in cm?

simpler.hi: 16 ka aadha nikalo. Jo aaye, wahi compass ka khulaav hai.
simpler.en: Find half of 16. Whatever you get is the compass opening.

why.hi: compass ka khulaav radius hai, aur 16 ka aadha 8 hai
why.en: the compass opening is the radius, and half of 16 is 8

answer.hi: compass ko scale se 8 cm kholo, nok O par rakho, aur khulaav badle bina pencil ek poora chakkar ghumao
answer.en: open the compass to 8 cm with the ruler, put its point on O, and turn the pencil one full round without changing the opening

why.hi: compass ka khulaav hi radius banta hai, aur 16 cm diameter ka aadha 8 cm hai
why.en: the compass opening becomes the radius, and half of the 16 cm diameter is 8 cm

prompt.hi: Anu ne compass 10 cm khol kar ek gol design banaya. Ravi ne 20 cm diameter ka gol design banaya. Kiska design bada hai, ya dono barabar hain?
prompt.en: Anu opened her compass to 10 cm and drew a round design. Ravi drew a round design with a 20 cm diameter. Whose design is bigger, or are they equal?

why.hi: Anu ka 10 cm khulaav radius hai, toh uska diameter 2 × 10 = 20 cm, Ravi jitna
why.en: Anu's 10 cm opening is the radius, so her diameter is 2 × 10 = 20 cm, the same as Ravi's

simpler.hi: Anu ke compass ka khulaav uske design ka radius hai. Uska diameter nikal kar Ravi ke diameter se milao.
simpler.en: Anu's compass opening is her design's radius. Work out her diameter and compare it with Ravi's.

prompt.hi: Sohan ne compass 5 cm khola aur poore chakkar mein khulaav ek baar bhi nahi badla. Kya bani shape ka har point centre se 5 cm par hoga: haan ya nahi?
prompt.en: Sohan opened the compass to 5 cm and the opening never changed during the whole turn. Will every point of the shape drawn be 5 cm from the centre: yes or no?

why.hi: khulaav kabhi nahi badla, toh pencil har jagah nok se 5 cm par hi chali
why.en: the opening never changed, so the pencil stayed 5 cm from the point everywhere

simpler.hi: Nok aur pencil ke beech ki doori poore chakkar mein ek jaisi rahi. Socho, pencil ke bane points centre se kitni door honge.
simpler.en: The gap between the point and the pencil stayed the same all the way round. Think how far the pencil's points are from the centre.

prompt.hi: Poster par 24 cm diameter wale circle ka ek arc banana hai. Compass ki nok centre par rakhkar, compass kitna khologe?
prompt.en: An arc of a circle with a 24 cm diameter is to be drawn on a poster. With the compass point on the centre, how wide will you open the compass?

why.hi: arc bhi usi circle ka hissa hai, toh khulaav radius hai, 24 ÷ 2 = 12
why.en: the arc is part of the same circle, so the opening is the radius, 24 ÷ 2 = 12

simpler.hi: Arc usi circle ka hissa hai, toh khulaav radius hi hai. 24 cm diameter ka aadha nikalo.
simpler.en: The arc is part of the same circle, so the opening is the radius. Find half of the 24 cm diameter.

ladder.why: a design 12 cm across → open to half the width, 6 cm
error-spot: Rohan opens to the full 8 cm diameter → what circle comes out, and the right opening
an arc from a circle 10 cm across → open to half the width, 5 cm, before drawing

remediation.move: where the compass sits on the circle: point on the centre, pencil on the edge → the opening spans centre → edge only = radius; the diameter spans edge → edge = two openings; so opening = diameter ÷ 2

say.hi: Compass ki nok centre par tikti hai aur pencil kinaare par chalti hai. Isliye khulaav sirf centre se kinaare tak hota hai, yaani radius, jo diameter ka aadha hai.
say.en: The compass point rests on the centre and the pencil moves on the edge. So the opening is only from the centre to the edge, that is the radius, which is half the diameter.

simpler.hi: Compass ki nok centre par hai aur pencil kinaare par. Khulaav centre se kinaare tak hai, yaani radius, jo diameter ka aadha hai.
simpler.en: The compass point is on the centre and the pencil on the edge. The opening is centre to edge: the radius, half the diameter.

prompt.hi: {friendF} ka compass 20 cm tak hi khulta hai. Kya woh 36 cm diameter ka circle bana sakti hai: haan ya nahi?
prompt.en: {friendF}'s compass opens only up to 20 cm. Can she draw a circle with a 36 cm diameter: yes or no?

why.hi: khulaav sirf radius jitna chahiye, 36 ÷ 2 = 18 cm, jo 20 cm se kam hai
why.en: the opening only needs to be the radius, 36 ÷ 2 = 18 cm, which is less than 20 cm

simpler.hi: Nok centre par, pencil kinaare par. Socho, iske liye compass kitna khulna chahiye, aur kya 20 cm kaafi hai.
simpler.en: Point on the centre, pencil on the edge. Think how wide that needs the compass, and whether 20 cm is enough.

remediation.move: the compass opening as a tight string from a peg: the string never gets longer or shorter while the chalk goes round → every mark the same distance from the peg; a fixed opening = the same radius in every direction

say.hi: Compass ka khulaav khoonti se bandhi tight dori jaisa hai. Dori ki lambai nahi badli, toh har nishaan centre se utni hi door aata hai, kisi bhi taraf.
say.en: The compass opening is like a tight string tied to a peg. The string's length did not change, so every mark comes the same distance from the centre, in any direction.

simpler.hi: Khulaav tight dori jaisa hai, uski lambai nahi badalti. Isliye har nishaan centre se utni hi door hai.
simpler.en: The opening is like a tight string; its length does not change. So every mark is the same distance from the centre.

prompt.hi: Compass 6 cm khol kar poora ghumaya, khulaav nahi badla. Kinaare ke do points ki centre se doori mein kitna antar hai?
prompt.en: A compass opened 6 cm turned a full round unchanged. How much do two edge points' distances from the centre differ?

why.hi: khulaav nahi badla, toh dono points centre se 6 cm par hain, aur 6 − 6 = 0
why.en: the opening did not change, so both points are 6 cm from the centre, and 6 − 6 = 0

simpler.hi: Khulaav poore chakkar mein ek jaisa raha. Socho, dono points centre se kitni door hain.
simpler.en: The opening stayed the same all the way round. Think how far each point is from the centre.

bridgeToNext.hi: Compass ne dikhaya ki circle ka har point centre se ek hi doori par hota hai. Agle hisse mein isi baat se pata karenge ki koi cheez circle par hai, andar hai ya bahar.
bridgeToNext.en: The compass showed that every point of a circle is the same distance from the centre. In the next part we will use this to tell whether something is on the circle, inside it or outside it.

simpler.hi: Ab dekhenge ki koi cheez circle par hai, andar hai ya bahar. Board par beech ke bindu ke chaaron taraf ek circle bana hai.
simpler.en: Now we see whether something is on a circle, inside it or outside it. On the board a circle is drawn all around the middle dot.

hook.convey: a circle = all the points one fixed distance from one point → an animal tied to a peg can go exactly a rope's length every way, its farthest reach traces a circle; a round garden bed whose edge is the same distance from its middle everywhere

use.hi: Koi animal, jaise ek bakri, khoonti se 3 m ki rassi se bandhi ho, toh woh har taraf khoonti se 3 m tak hi ja sakti hai. Uski pahunch ka kinaara ek circle banata hai.
use.en: If an animal, say a goat, is tied to a peg with a 3 m rope, it can go only up to 3 m from the peg in every direction. The edge of its reach makes a circle.

use.hi: Garden mein gol kyari ka kinaara uske beech ke bindu se har jagah ek hi doori par hota hai. Isi se pata chalta hai ki koi paudha kinaare par hai, andar hai ya bahar.
use.en: In a garden, the edge of a round flower bed is the same distance from its middle point everywhere. That is how we tell whether a plant is on the edge, inside or outside.

explain.convey: children standing around a tree, each exactly 7 m from it → all such places together make a circle with the tree as centre and radius 7 m → there are countless such points

point.hi: Maan lo ek ped ke chaaron taraf bachche khade hain, har bachcha ped se theek 7 m door. Aise saare points milkar ek circle banate hain, jiska centre ped hai aur radius 7 m. Is circle ka har point ped se utni hi doori par hai.
point.en: Say children stand all around a tree, each child exactly 7 m from the tree. All such points together make a circle whose centre is the tree and radius is 7 m. Every point of this circle is at that same distance from the tree.

prompt.hi: Ped se theek 7 m door kitne points ho sakte hain: sirf 4, sirf 8, ya anginat, jinhe gina hi na ja sake?
prompt.en: How many points can be exactly 7 m from the tree: only 4, only 8, or countless, too many to count?

why.hi: circle ka har point ped se 7 m par hai, aur circle par points kabhi khatam nahi hote
why.en: every point of the circle is 7 m from the tree, and the points on a circle never run out

simpler.hi: Har bachcha ped se theek 7 m door khada hai. Aise saare points ek circle par aate hain, jiska centre ped hai.
simpler.en: Each child stands exactly 7 m from the tree. All such points lie on one circle, with the tree as its centre.

explain.convey: compare a point's distance from the centre with the radius: equal → on the circle; less → inside; more → outside; circle of radius 6 m on the board, the child places a point 8 m away

point.hi: Is circle ka centre O hai aur radius 6 m. Jo point O se theek 6 m door hai, woh circle par hai. Jo 6 m se kam door hai, woh andar hai, aur jo 6 m se zyada door hai, woh circle ke bahar hai.
point.en: This circle has centre O and radius 6 m. A point exactly 6 m from O is on the circle. A point less than 6 m away is inside, and a point more than 6 m away is outside the circle.

prompt.hi: Ek point O se 4 m door hai. Woh is circle ke andar hai, circle par hai, ya bahar?
prompt.en: A point is 4 m from O. Is it inside this circle, on the circle, or outside?

why.hi: 4 m radius ke 6 m se kam hai
why.en: 4 m is less than the 6 m radius

simpler.hi: Radius 6 m hai, toh point ki doori ko 6 m se milao. Barabar ho toh circle par, zyada ho toh bahar, aur kam ho toh kya hoga, khud socho.
simpler.en: The radius is 6 m, so compare the point's distance with 6 m. Equal means on the circle, more means outside, and think for yourself what less means.

problem.hi: Park mein ek gol kyari hai, jiska centre O hai aur radius 4 m. Nal T, O se 4 m door hai, bench B 3 m door hai, aur gate G 5 m door hai. Kaun kyari ke kinaare par hai, kaun andar, aur kaun bahar?
problem.en: A park has a round flower bed with centre O and radius 4 m. Tap T is 4 m from O, bench B is 3 m away, and gate G is 5 m away. Which is on the edge of the bed, which is inside, and which is outside?

simpler.hi: Kyari ka centre O aur radius 4 m hai. Nal T, bench B aur gate G, O se 4 m, 3 m aur 5 m door hain. Har ek kinaare par, andar ya bahar hai, yeh batana hai.
simpler.en: The flower bed has centre O and radius 4 m. Tap T, bench B and gate G are 4 m, 3 m and 5 m from O. We name each as on the edge, inside or outside.

givens.hi: centre O hai aur radius 4 m
nal T, O se 4 m door hai
givens.en: tap T is 4 m from O

givens.hi: bench B, O se 3 m door hai
givens.en: bench B is 3 m from O

givens.hi: gate G, O se 5 m door hai
givens.en: gate G is 5 m from O

find.hi: T, B aur G mein se kaun kinaare par hai, kaun andar aur kaun bahar
find.en: which of T, B and G is on the edge, inside, and outside

steps.result: kinaare par matlab O se theek 4 m

why.hi: circle ka har point centre se theek ek radius door hota hai
why.en: every point of a circle is exactly one radius from the centre

simpler.hi: Circle ka har point centre se theek ek radius door hota hai. Yahan radius 4 m hai.
simpler.en: Every point of a circle is exactly one radius from the centre. Here the radius is 4 m.

do.hi: Nal T ki doori radius se milao: 4 m aur 4 m
do.en: Compare tap T's distance with the radius: 4 m and 4 m

why.hi: uski doori radius ke barabar hai
why.en: its distance equals the radius

simpler.hi: Tap T, O se 4 m door hai, aur radius bhi 4 m hai. Dono barabar hain, isliye T kinaare par hai.
simpler.en: Tap T is 4 m from O, and the radius is 4 m too. They are equal, so T is on the edge.

do.hi: Bench B ki doori radius se milao: 3 m aur 4 m
do.en: Compare bench B's distance with the radius: 3 m and 4 m

why.hi: woh centre se radius se kam doori par hai
why.en: it is less than a radius from the centre

simpler.hi: Bench B, O se 3 m door hai, jo 4 m se kam hai. Isliye B andar hai.
simpler.en: Bench B is 3 m from O, which is less than 4 m. So B is inside.

prompt.hi: Gate G, O se 5 m door hai aur radius 4 m. G kyari ke andar hai, kinaare par, ya bahar?
prompt.en: Gate G is 5 m from O and the radius is 4 m. Is G inside the bed, on the edge, or outside?

simpler.hi: G ki doori 5 m hai aur radius 4 m. Dekho G ki doori radius se zyada hai ya kam.
simpler.en: G is 5 m away and the radius is 4 m. See whether G's distance is more or less than the radius.

why.hi: G ki doori 5 m hai, jo radius ke 4 m se zyada hai
why.en: G is 5 m away, which is more than the 4 m radius

answer.hi: nal T kinaare par hai, bench B andar hai, aur gate G bahar hai
answer.en: tap T is on the edge, bench B is inside, and gate G is outside

why.hi: kinaare ka har point centre se theek 4 m door hai, isse kam doori andar aur zyada doori bahar hoti hai
why.en: every point of the edge is exactly 4 m from the centre; less than that is inside and more is outside

prompt.hi: Dhaba D har taraf 3 km tak free delivery deta hai. Ghar A, D se uttar mein 3 km door hai aur ghar B dakshin mein 4 km. Kya dono gharon ko free delivery milegi: haan ya nahi?
prompt.en: Dhaba D delivers free up to 3 km in every direction. House A is 3 km north of D and house B is 4 km south. Will both houses get free delivery: yes or no?

why.hi: A theek 3 km par, circle par hai, par B 4 km door, 3 km radius ke bahar hai
why.en: A is exactly 3 km away, on the circle, but B is 4 km away, outside the 3 km radius

simpler.hi: Free delivery 3 km radius wale circle tak hai. Har ghar ki doori ko 3 km se milao.
simpler.en: Free delivery reaches the circle of radius 3 km. Compare each house's distance with 3 km.

prompt.hi: Ek bakri 4 m ki rassi se khoonti par bandhi hai. Woh jitni gol jagah mein ghaas char sakti hai, us jagah ki poori chaudai kitni hai?
prompt.en: A goat is tied to a peg with a 4 m rope. The round patch it can graze: how wide is it all the way across?

why.hi: rassi radius hai, aur poori chaudai diameter hai, 2 × 4 = 8
why.en: the rope is the radius, and the width all across is the diameter, 2 × 4 = 8

simpler.hi: Rassi radius hai, 4 m. Poori chaudai diameter hai, jo do radius jitni hoti hai.
simpler.en: The rope is the radius, 4 m. The width all across is the diameter, which is two radii.

ladder.why: two stations exactly 4 km from a hub → both on the circle of radius 4 km
chairs each 5 m from a flagpole → on a circle, pole as centre
explain why a string tied to a peg draws a perfect circle

remediation.move: rangoli with a peg and a tight string: the chalk goes round, the string never stretches or shrinks → measure the string at the top, the side, the bottom-left → the same every time → one radius in every direction

say.hi: Rangoli ke liye khoonti se dori baandhi aur chalk ghumaya. Dori tight rahi aur uski lambai kahin nahi badli, isliye har nishaan khoonti se utni hi door hai.
say.en: For a rangoli, a string was tied to a peg and the chalk was taken round. The string stayed tight and its length never changed, so every mark is the same distance from the peg.

simpler.hi: Dori ki lambai kabhi nahi badli. Isliye har nishaan khoonti se utni hi door hai.
simpler.en: The string's length never changed. So every mark is the same distance from the peg.

prompt.hi: 2 m ki tight dori se rangoli bani. {friendM} kehta hai ek nishaan khoonti se 3 m par hai. Ho sakta hai: haan ya nahi?
prompt.en: A tight 2 m string on a peg drew a rangoli. {friendM} says one mark is 3 m from the peg. Can that be: yes or no?

why.hi: dori 2 m ki hi rahi, toh har nishaan khoonti se 2 m par hai, 3 m par koi nahi
why.en: the string stayed 2 m, so every mark is 2 m from the peg; none is at 3 m

simpler.hi: Dori ki lambai 2 m thi aur badli nahi. Socho, koi nishaan 3 m door kaise aata.
simpler.en: The string was 2 m and did not change. Think how any mark could land 3 m away.

remediation.move: the tied animal reaches one rope-length on one side of the peg and one rope-length on the opposite side → the full width across = rope + rope = 2 × radius, never the rope alone

say.hi: Bakri khoonti ke ek taraf rassi bhar ja sakti hai, aur ulti taraf bhi rassi bhar. Isliye us gol jagah ki poori chaudai rassi ki dugni hai.
say.en: The goat can go one rope-length on one side of the peg, and one rope-length on the opposite side too. So the full width of that round patch is twice the rope.

simpler.hi: Bakri ek taraf rassi bhar jaati hai, aur ulti taraf bhi rassi bhar. Isliye poori chaudai rassi ki dugni hai.
simpler.en: The goat goes one rope-length each way from the peg. So the full width is twice the rope.

prompt.hi: Ek gol talaab 30 m chauda hai, aur uske theek beech mein fountain hai. Fountain se kinaare tak kitni doori hai?
prompt.en: A round pond is 30 m across, with a fountain right in its middle. How far is it from the fountain to the edge?

why.hi: poori chaudai diameter hai, aur fountain se kinaare tak uska aadha, 30 ÷ 2 = 15
why.en: the width across is the diameter, and the fountain to the edge is half of it, 30 ÷ 2 = 15

simpler.hi: Talaab ki poori chaudai uska diameter hai. Fountain se kinaare tak uska aadha hota hai.
simpler.en: The pond's full width is its diameter. From the fountain to the edge is half of that.
